name: dogclap
description: Your code failed. The dog noticed. A fun dog that blames you whenever a command fails.

dogclap.enabledCommands.markdownDescription: Commands that trigger the dog after a successful run. `["*"]` keeps the built-in build and run detection. Add `all` to match every terminal command (e.g. `curl`, `ls`). Add entries such as `npm`, `python`, `node`, `executable`, `tasks` or `debug`. An empty list disables celebrations.

dogclap.triggerOn.markdownDescription: When to show the dog: after commands that succeed (exit code 0), fail (non-zero exit code), or both. Applies to terminal commands, tasks and debug sessions.

dogclap.failureGifPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a GIF/PNG/SVG shown on failure. Empty falls back to `dogclap.gifPath`.

dogclap.failureSoundPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `.wav` played on failure. Empty falls back to `dogclap.soundPath`.

dogclap.gifPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom GIF/PNG/SVG shown on success. Empty uses the bundled `media/dogclap.gif`.

dogclap.soundPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom `.wav` sound (WAV works on every OS). Empty uses the bundled `media/dogclap.wav`.

dogclap.position.description: Where the dog appears in the editor.

dogclap.bottomOffsetPx.description: Distance in pixels from the last visible line when the position is bottom-right. Increase it if the dog is cut off at the bottom.

dogclap.sizePx.markdownDescription: Width and height of the animation in pixels.

dogclap.durationMs.markdownDescription: How long the animation stays visible, in milliseconds.

dogclap.playSound.description: Play the sound together with the animation.
